paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
coupling_convention: g_aNN in GeV^-1 (NOT dimensionless; convention as plotted)
notes: NASDUCK-SERF SERF comagnetometer (3He + 39K) constrains both ALP-neutron (g_aNN) and ALP-proton (g_aPP) couplings over mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. Note: couplings are reported in GeV^-1 (derivative-coupling convention with dimension of GeV^-1), NOT the dimensionless g_an convention typical for AxionNeutron. Data points are approximate readings from the mean exclusion line in Fig. 2 (left panel, neutron); precise tabulated bounds are in the GitHub repository [57]. The paper also reports ALP-proton bounds (g_aPP ~5e-6 to ~1e-2 GeV^-1, first reliable terrestrial proton bound). 95% C.L.
